correctness.rationale: 24-vertex norm-one maximizers and 4-dimensional volume two localize the tail; exact e1 cube tangent parametrization gives 3 times an integral of the fourth power of a quadratic root. Rational uniform Taylor expansion and exact cube moments E U=1, E U^2=19/15 yield 24,48,772/5. The checked standalone script independently recomputes these exact values. Extreme-value limit and cube coefficient are analytically justified. Quadrature is not used to prove asymptotics.

This is provisional priority, not a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: Quantizer near-worst-case error tails have a concrete role in rare-failure and maximum-error calibration, distinct from minimizing mean-square error. The first three exact coefficients, all-order analytic rational recurrence, and Weibull extreme-value normalization describe the D4 cell at its sharp covering radius. The cube benchmark is natural at a common radius and is explicitly not an equal-covolume comparison.
